sources.note: Main website. EndoSoft founded 1995, 50-100 employees, 100K+ clinical users, 100+ hospitals, 40+ countries. Procedure-based specialty EHR focused on endoscopy, GI, oncology, pulmonology.
ONC mandatory disclosures for EndoVault 3.2. Lists 41+ certified criteria. Notes additional costs for certified functionality.

EndoVault product page. Describes core modules: scheduler, procedure documentation, PACS, ENR, patient portal, reporting. 150+ prebuilt reports, up to 4 video signals, Surescripts e-prescribing, CPOE.
Features overview. Lists scheduler, procedure documentation, image management, ENR, patient portal, reporting, Argus AI. Customizable pick lists and templates.

GI-specific page. Documents GI workflows from consult to discharge, quality tracking (polyp detection, bowel prep scores), registry integration (GIQuIC, AGA, MIPS/MACRA, CDC). CMS/TJC/AGA/ASGE/ACG compliance.

Image management and PACS details. Captures 4K HD images (BMP, JPEG, TIF, DICOM), 4K video (AVI). Vendor-neutral, works with Olympus, Pentax, Fujinon, Stryker. DICOM-compliant, HL7 visible light worklists.
Scheduler module details. Multi-provider, multi-facility scheduling. Recall management with automated reminders (text, email, phone). Role-based access.

ENR module details. Automatic vital sign recording, medication administration/reconciliation, patient tracking, intra/post-procedure documentation, RFID/barcode inventory, time and material billing, scope tracking.
Technical solutions page. Data migration capabilities, HL7/FHIR integration, interfaces with Epic, Cerner, McKesson, Meditech. ADT, scheduling, orders, results, pathology, billing messages.

Oncology-specific features. Cancer staging (TNM, ICD-O-3), chemotherapy management with dose calculations, radiation therapy ordering, MAR, cancer registry interfacing, tumor board, clinical trial consent, adverse reaction tracking.
About page. Founded 1995 by Rakesh and Manish Madan. Subsidiary of Utech Products Inc. 50-100 employees, Schenectady NY HQ. International offices in 7+ countries.

FAQs. Runs on Microsoft SQL and Interbase. Electronic signatures supported. Scope-neutral. Epic Lumens integration available. Data migration experience. No mention of built-in billing/practice management.
Third-party listing. ONC-certified multi-specialty EHR for procedure-focused specialties. Custom pricing based on facility size and modules. 3/5 rating from 2 reviews. HL7/FHIR compatible.
Patient portal page. Minimal detail — lists Patient Portal & Mobile App as a module but does not elaborate on specific patient-facing features.
